name: familiar
description: Familiar names (#433): the geometry, light and camera words agents know from web 3D libraries, with their parameter names and defaults, each a recipe over scene3d's trusted builders with its conversion stated. A word or value with no mapping is refused, never guessed.

BoxGeometry.conversion: its parameters by name; angles in degrees; Object3D's rotation (XYZ) through the rotation matrix to ours (Rz·Ry·Rx), its pivot to our position plus that pivot

MeshStandardMaterial.conversion: Color sRGB to linear base_color; roughness kept; metalness to metallic

PointLight.conversion: power = 4π × intensity (cd), kept in lumens; Color sRGB to linear; decay 2 only

SpotLight.conversion: power × 4 (the library's spot counts π × cd, ours 4π × cd); angle the outer half angle; penumbra to inner

PerspectiveCamera.conversion: vertical fov to ours across the wider side, 2·atan(tan(fov/2)·aspect) when aspect ≥ 1; local −Z forward to our target
